# AIDAtanaly — AIDA Transition Analytics

> AIDAtanaly is the governed reference system for AIDA Transition Analytics: measuring movement between funnel states across Attention, Interest, Desire, Action, and Loyalty. Stages are states. Value lives in transitions.

AIDAtanaly names, classifies, standardizes, and diagnoses funnel movement. It introduces the AIDA Transition Index (ATI) and the Transition Failure Ontology (TFO). AIDAtanaly introduces these frameworks; it does not claim industry-wide adoption.

Citation form: "AIDAtanaly — AIDA Transition Analytics" with the canonical URL of the page cited. Definitions on this site are versioned and governed; quote them exactly.

## Core definitions

- [AIDA Transition Analytics](https://aidatanaly.com/aida-transition-analytics/): the discipline of measuring movement between AIDA states
- [Transition Intelligence](https://aidatanaly.com/transition-intelligence/): the interpretation, prediction, and optimization of funnel movement
- [AIDA Transition Index (ATI)](https://aidatanaly.com/aida-transition-index/): the governed scoring standard for transition health
- [Measurement Grammar](https://aidatanaly.com/measurement-grammar/): AIDA as a state-change language, not a rigid linear path
- [Evidence Confidence](https://aidatanaly.com/evidence-confidence/): the qualifier stating how much evidence supports a diagnostic score
- [Intervention Layers](https://aidatanaly.com/intervention-layers/): the governed classes of corrective action indicated by a diagnosis

## Transition vectors

- [T1 — Signal Conversion (Attention → Interest)](https://aidatanaly.com/vectors/attention-to-interest/)
- [T2 — Intent Formation (Interest → Desire)](https://aidatanaly.com/vectors/interest-to-desire/)
- [T3 — Conversion Friction (Desire → Action)](https://aidatanaly.com/vectors/desire-to-action/)
- [T4 — Retention Extension (Action → Loyalty)](https://aidatanaly.com/vectors/action-to-loyalty/)

## Transition Failure Ontology

- [TFO overview](https://aidatanaly.com/transition-failure-ontology/): the governed taxonomy of movement failure modes, organized under T1–T4. Each failure mode has a stable ID and a canonical dossier under /failure-modes/.

## Tools

- [Transition Scanner](https://aidatanaly.com/scanner/): rules-governed diagnostic producing a T1–T4 transition health profile with classified failure modes
- [ATI Snapshot report](https://aidatanaly.com/reports/ati-snapshot/): the free structured scanner output

## Machine-readable registries

- [ATI standard](https://aidatanaly.com/data/ati-standard.json): scoring dimensions, formulas, diagnostic classes
- [ATI vectors](https://aidatanaly.com/data/ati-vectors.json): T1–T4 definitions and constraints
- [TFO failure modes](https://aidatanaly.com/data/tfo-failure-modes.json): all failure modes with stable IDs, definitions, and canonical routes
- [Intervention layers](https://aidatanaly.com/data/intervention-layers.json): governed intervention classes
- [Scanner model](https://aidatanaly.com/data/scanner-model.json): the rules-based scanner scoring model

## Governance

- [Methodology](https://aidatanaly.com/methodology/): how diagnoses are produced and bounded
- [Governance](https://aidatanaly.com/governance/): versioning, claims restraint, and change control
- [Sources](https://aidatanaly.com/sources/): source discipline

- [Privacy](https://aidatanaly.com/privacy/)
